stance: Housing is weak at a low level and softened further. Existing sales fell 5.5% to 3.75M SAAR (prior revised to 3.97M), the lagged effect of mortgage rates near 7.4%. September starts fell 5.2% to 1,221k and permits held near 1,400k (-0.2%), so starts should stabilise. New home sales of 676k were flat. Residential investment remains a GDP drag. Permits below 1,350k or new home sales falling further would confirm deterioration. View is provisional.
